mapper.insert: insert into media_favorite (owner_key, kind, target_id, album_id, seq) select #{ownerKey}, #{kind}, #{targetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{albumId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{seq,jdbcType=INTEGER} from dual where not exists (select 1 from media_favorite where )
mapper.update: update media_favorite set created_at = current_timestamp(3) where
mapper.select: select f.kind, f.target_id, f.album_id, f.seq, f.created_at as happened_at, coalesce(v.title, a.title) as title from media_favorite f left join media_video v on f.kind = 'video' and v.id = f.target_id left join media_album a on f.kind = 'photo' and a.id = f.album_id where f.owner_key = #{ownerKey} order by f.created_at desc, f.id desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from media_favorite where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and kind = #{kind}
mapper.delete: delete from media_favorite where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and id not in (select id from ( select id from media_favorite where owner_key = #{ownerKey} order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{keep}) k)
